llm.summary: This appears to be a legitimate disposable email integration, but it needs Review because shared agents can read full inbox contents such as verification links and OTPs.

dimensions.detail: Use of AgentPMT MCP/REST endpoints is expected for an AgentPMT-hosted tool, but email contents and verification messages flow through that external service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No local command runtime is declared for the skill itself, but the setup references include unpinned npx skills install commands for related AgentPMT setup skills.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation terms include broad words such as check, email, and create, which are wider than necessary for a tool that can create inboxes and read full message bodies.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifacts contain no background worker, persistence mechanism, local credential harvesting, or privilege escalation instructions; credential handling is delegated to setup guidance and the skill warns not to put secrets in prompts or logs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The create/check/fetch capabilities match the disposable email purpose, but the artifact discloses full message retrieval and same-budget cross-agent inbox access while also saying inboxes must be ones the user created, leaving the sharing boundary ambiguous for sensitive emails.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using AgentPMT-hosted disposable inboxes where other agents on the same budget may be able to inspect messages. Do not use it for personal, financial, production, or high-value accounts; isolate agent groups or budgets for private workflows, and prefer explicit temporary-inbox requests over generic email tasks.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Full inbox retrieval is core to this tool, but the shared same-budget access model is sensitive enough that users should get clearer warning and isolation guidance.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad activation language is not necessary for a disposable email skill and increases the chance of accidental use in unrelated email or create/check workflows.
[RP1] unexpected: The unpinned npx examples are install guidance for adjacent setup skills rather than automatic execution, but pinned or provenance-controlled installs would reduce supply-chain risk.
[E1] expected: The AgentPMT external endpoints are consistent with the hosted-tool design; this is not evidence of hidden exfiltration by itself, but users should understand inbox data leaves the local agent environment.
